meta.title: Revive Physio Clinic | Physiotherapy & Private Pilates in Bangkok
meta.description: Revive Physio Clinic at Hub 24, Ramkhamhaeng — physiotherapy and private Pilates led by licensed physical therapists. Rehab, pregnancy, elderly and sport care.

hero.eyebrow: We Make Your Health Our Priority
hero.sub: At Revive Physio Clinic, we make sure to offer you the highest quality of Physio Therapy and Private Pilates classes.

strength.heading: Our Strength
strength.text: Harnessing our instructors' physiotherapy expertise, we excel in not only rehabilitation but also in promoting overall well-being, including sports performance, injury prevention, and general exercise care for our clients at Revive Physio Clinic.

services.title: Physio Therapy
services.desc: Physiotherapy can help improve or restore mobility, strength, movement, range of motion, and overall functioning, decrease pain and prevent further injuries. It can help with persistent pain including chronic pain, acute pain, nerve pain, office syndrome, post-surgical complications, and sport injuries.

services.title: Private Pilates
services.desc: Pilates can help increase muscle strength, endurance and flexibility, and improve posture and balance. Aside from the traditional private Pilates session, we also offer 4 types of private Pilates services below.

pilatesTypes.title: Pregnancy Pilates
pilatesTypes.desc: Private Pilates session tailor made for pregnancy. Suitable for pregnancy during the 2nd and 3rd trimester.

pilatesTypes.title: Elderly Pilates
pilatesTypes.desc: Private Pilates low-impact session tailor made for the elderly. Suitable for people who have limited mobility or joint pain due to aging.

pilatesTypes.title: Rehabilitation Pilates
pilatesTypes.desc: Private Pilates session tailor made to help you heal and return to balance. Suitable for problems including scoliosis, post-surgery rehab, joint rehab, and chronic pain management.

pilatesTypes.title: Duo Pilates
pilatesTypes.desc: The more the merrier. We offer a Duo Private Pilates session, suitable for people who want to bring a family member or friend to work out together.
